messages:
maria_pm: Quick sync — pilot asks re: "Compact Add-On" packaging. Two pilots (eduapp & commsco) want a soft upper-limit instead of a hard cutoff and a 30d tolerance period before enforced overage billing. Thinking: soft-throttle -> notification -> grace window -> bill. Need legal + finance + eng input.

david_sales: both customers said month-end spikes hit them hard, they prefer throttling to complete drops. They asked if we can give a one-time buffer on contract sign. :+1:

aj_eng: we can do a throttling path + a burst bucket that drains over time. Implementation notes:
 - requires per-tenant burst accounting and KV cache isolation
 - small perf risk at 95p during simultaneous spikes
 - rough estimate: 2 sprints to build and test path + config flags for cap vs soft-cap.

liz_finance: We can't leave an open-ended grace. Proposals: add pre-paid buffer, or a 20% overage surcharge after grace, or limited tolerance events (eg 1-3 per year). Need revenue model for each.

sam_legal: We can accept a "soft cap" offering but must define it in contract. Suggested clause (draft):
 ```
 Soft Cap & Tolerance Events: Provider may apply a soft throttling mechanism when usage exceeds the Subscription Limit. Customer will receive notifications on threshold breaches. Provider will allow up to 30 calendar days for the Customer to rectify usage before overage billing is applied. The Provider may grant up to 3 Tolerance Events per 12-month period at its discretion; additional events will be billed per the Overage Rate.
 ```
Small change: define "Overage Rate" in fee schedule and cap tolerance events.

nora_devex: UX: Console should show a "buffer remaining" meter, an estimated time-to-throttle, and a preemptive alert email/sms webhook. Also add a clear CTA to purchase extra buffer. I can mock the UI in a day.

opsbot: [automated] created TRACK-1049 (Compact Add-On: soft-cap mechanics), assigned to @aj_eng.

aj_eng: follow-up on infra: need to ensure billing telemetry tags the burst usage separately so finance can reconcile. Also will need rollout flags for Dedicated vs Hosted since private deployments have different enforcement.

maria_pm: Proposed launch criteria for SMB pilot:
 - Legal-approved soft-cap clause in MSA and SOW
 - Billing telemetry surfaced in console and reporting
 - E2E tests for throttle/burst accounting
 - Pilot customers signed with clear tolerance events and pricing
 - Finance sign-off on unit economics (no negative margin)

david_sales: If legal signs off, we can include one-time concession on pilot contracts to get early feedback. Sales will capture feedback and escalation points.

liz_finance: I'll build a simple P&L: baseline, conservative, optimistic, and include surcharge scenarios. Will share by EOD Thursday.

sam_legal: Approve in principle. Edit: restrict tolerance-events to 3 per rolling 12 months and require written request for any exceptions.

maria_pm: OK — next steps: aj_eng & nora_devex to scope UI + infra tasks, liz to produce P&L, sam to finalize clause, david to prepare pilot offers. Weekly check-in Wed 10am. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
